decision.two_fully_qualified_controls_suffice_for: a separately preregistered one-shot conditional control challenge reporting individual material outcomes
two_controls_do_not_establish: population recall or calibrated probability validity
within-ChemCam performance of the different-instrument BAM measurement
decision.current_go_no_go: Do not open final intensities or score yet: GOE100 family overlap/assay applicability and BAM310 numeric source, axis and certified-region linkage remain unresolved. GOE documentary vacuum/nm is supported.
decision.ordinary_negative_stratum: separate ordinary negatives plus positives and >=2 independent clusters per each group are chosen full-campaign software requirements, not logical prerequisites to a material-specific control outcome
decision.conditional_challenge_vs_independent_fin: One-shot conditional score challenge is not evidence of independent final validation unless physical/family overlap is excluded and chemistry applicability is independently established. A narrow qualified control validation still does not complete the old full campaign.

goe100.chemistry_kind: independent LA-ICP-MS spot assay, not LIBS model-derived labels
goe100.actual_preparation_evidence: Commercial Sigma Aldrich goethite independently analyzed; 100% endmember in mixture table; mixtures pressed into 13 mm pellets under 10 ton, 5 LIBS positions. Source-campaign grouping is acceptable without guessed date; stock/family relation remains unresolved.

assumptions: Eight locations represent the same prepared material and target measurand.
Errors/spot values are independent with a suitable normal sampling model; eight spots do not verify this assumption.
Assay scale/calibration and matrix effects are acceptably unbiased or separately bounded.
No change of physical stock or preparation invalidates the chemistry-to-spectrum link.
does_not_bound: all grains or all future local spots

operational_roles.Mg: candidate low-content matrix control conditional on independent assay applicability and scope; not strict absence or historical method blank
operational_roles.Fe: positive composition control if same-material linkage is confirmed

goe100.independence_blocker: GOE100 versus previously seen GOEDV stock/family unresolved; different chemistry/name alone does not clear overlap
minimum_extra_evidence: Trace same assayed stock/prepared endmember to archived GOE100 measurement and resolve GOEDV parent-family relation.

Evidence that reported quantitative method/standards or independent assay validation support the scale in this matrix; formal CoA or new interlaboratory study is not inherently required. A conditional challenge may explicitly retain the unverified residual bias assumption, but cannot call it a certified bound.

GOE vacuum/nm and LANL processing are supported by David2020 to Clegg2017 documentation; numerical coverage must still be checked under a locked manifest. Source-campaign grouping is sufficient without invented acquisition date; per-spot CE5 to #n mapping is not established.
Predeclare material-level mean composition/score aggregation and narrow conditional claim before numerical access.

bam310.upper_kind: upper endpoint of published certified mass-fraction interval; not maximum every microspot

candidate_roles.Fe: prospective operational low-Fe matrix control after actual surface/material linkage

minimum_extra_evidence: Licensed actual numerical file manifest identifying the measured BAM310 material and preparation.
Attributable statement or mapped positions establishing applicability of certificate to sampled surface/region; coordinate log is one option, not the only valid form.
Explicit air/vacuum export convention, actual coverage and resolution; air atmosphere and manufacturer line examples do not establish axis.
Explicit OOD scope for unchanged ChemCam profile; do not relabel instrument_id or fit response/thresholds on final.

minimal_limited_protocol.selection: both materials and all metadata-eligible replicate locations fixed before intensities; no best-spectrum selection
minimal_limited_protocol.predeclared_primary_aggregation: mean frozen score across all preselected valid replicate measurements per material, then compare actual frozen threshold; report every replicate too

negative_primary_outcomes.BAM310: Fe false-detection indicator on this physical material, OOD instrument
negative_primary_outcomes.GOE100: Mg false-detection indicator on this physical material, LANL if verified

minimal_limited_protocol.statistical_reporting: individual material outcomes, scores and counts; no useful population FPR/recall CI or pooling instruments/elements
minimal_limited_protocol.quality_failures: report predeclared structural/axis/coverage failures with reasons; do not replace materials or adjust processing using scores
minimal_limited_protocol.receipt_policy: persistent one-shot receipt and replay of exact result; no adaptive retraining/recalibration
minimal_limited_protocol.claim: independent final holdout for these named controls only, conditional on stated chemistry assumptions; does not close full schema3 final

primary_references.locator: David thesis section4.4 and FigureC.3 printedp255/PDFp271

primary_references.role: method bias and sample uncertainty cannot be removed by repeatability alone

review_limit: No new numerical final spectra, no predictions, no evidence attestation upgrades. Source-specific v7 findings from parallel metadata investigations require a final independent review before admission.
